title: Core: global sequence schema + counters + migration + shared task ref
summary: Global sequence schema + counters + migration + shared findTaskByRef
description:
Core data model changes in @agent-plan/core for stable global F/P/T numbering + shared ref resolution.

**Files:**
- packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:160,197,240 (Feature/Phase/Task `number`) + ProjectSchema — add `nextFeatureNumber`/`nextPhaseNumber`/`nextTaskNumber` (int, default 1) to ProjectSchema. Document `number` semantics: global, stable, assigned once at create, gaps on delete.
- packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:340 `normalizeStructureSnapshot` — REMOVE the per-parent renumbering (`phase.number = index+1` at L371-373, `feature.number = featureIndex+1` at L368-370, task renumbering in normalizePhaseDocument at L309-311 + L319-321). Keep ONLY: phaseIds/taskIds array repair, orphan-phase linking, structure integrity. Numbers stay as-is.
- packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts createPhase/createTask/createFeature — assign `number = project.nextXNumber++` from the counter, bump + persist the counter in project.json.
- NEW `migrateToGlobalSequence` in plan-store — one-time: collect all phases sorted by `createdAt` asc → reassign number 1..N; all tasks by createdAt asc → 1..N; all features by createdAt asc → 1..N; set `nextPhaseNumber/nextTaskNumber/nextFeatureNumber = max+1`. Idempotent: skip if no duplicate phase numbers AND no duplicate task numbers across the project (already global). Wire into the startup migration path (alongside migrateToUuids).
- packages/plan-core/src/refs.ts — add shared `findTaskByRef(phases, features, ref)` accepting: UUID, bare `T00x` (now unambiguous by global number), composite `F00x/P00x/T00x` + `P00x(F00x)/T00x`, 5-char shortId, title fallback. Update findPhaseByRef doc comment (number now truly global). Export both from core index.

**Edge cases:** deletion leaves a gap (counter monotonic, never reused); migration runs before normalize; counters persisted atomically with the create; existing per-parent data migrates on first load after deploy.

tasks.title: Schema: add global counters to ProjectSchema + document number semantics
tasks.description:
packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts — add `nextFeatureNumber`, `nextPhaseNumber`, `nextTaskNumber` (z.number().int().positive().default(1)) to ProjectSchema. These are monotonic global counters persisted in project.json, assigned at creation, never reused (gaps on delete). Document in the schema comment that Feature/Phase/Task `number` (L160/197/240) is now a GLOBAL stable project sequence (was per-feature/per-phase). Verify ProjectSchema.parse accepts existing project.json (defaults fill the new fields).

---
**Completion summary:**
packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts: added nextFeatureNumber/nextPhaseNumber/nextTaskNumber (int positive default 1) to ProjectSchema. Added doc comments to Feature/Phase/Task `number` fields noting they are now global stable sequences (bare P00x/T00x unambiguous). Also added the 3 counters to the init saveProject literal in plan-store.ts:512.

Verified: existing project.json files parse with default counters (1,1,1); explicit counters preserved (7,17,73); pnpm --filter @agent-plan/core build clean. NOTE: the edit tool silently failed to apply changes twice (returned only a reminder, no error) — used a node script with byte-exact 2-space indentation matching to apply successfully.

tasks.title: PlanStore: create assigns from global counter; normalize stops renumbering
tasks.description:
packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:
1. normalizeStructureSnapshot (L340-395) — REMOVE per-parent renumbering: delete `phase.number = index+1` (L371-373), `feature.number = featureIndex+1` (L368-370), and the task renumbering in normalizePhaseDocument (L309-311) + the feature renumber at L319-321. Keep ONLY phaseIds/taskIds array repair, orphan-phase linking, structure integrity. Numbers stay as-is (stable).
2. createPhase/createTask/createFeature — assign `number = project.nextXNumber++` from the persisted counter, then bump + save project.json. Ensure the counter is persisted atomically with the create (within withFeatureLock).

---
**Completion summary:**
Core side of global numbering done:

1. normalizeTasks (L306) + normalizeFeaturesDocument (L315) → no-op renumber (numbers stay as stored; was index+1 per-parent). They still return {tasks/doc, changed:false} for callers.
2. normalizeStructureSnapshot (L340) → removed feature.number renumber (L367-368), phase.number renumber for linked phases (L370-374) + orphans (L399-402). KEPT: phaseIds/taskIds array repair + orphan-phase linking + normalizePhaseDocument calls (taskIds repair). Return keeps feature.number as-is.
3. Added alloc helpers to PlanStore after loadProject: allocFeatureNumber()/allocPhaseNumber()/allocTaskNumber() → private allocSeqNumber(key) reads project counter, bumps + persists, returns n. Must be called within withFeatureLock (adapters do).

NOTE: creation lives in the ADAPTERS (plan-mcp L306/431/582, pi-adapter L1449/1831/2829/3234) which currently compute per-parent max+1. The adapter wiring to call allocXNumber() is Phase 2 (T6e8289 / Tb4e0ccf). The migration (T3, next) renumbers existing to global; the adapter wiring MUST ship in the same release as the migration (else new entities would collide with migrated global numbers). Both land before any @next release.

Verified: pnpm -r build + pnpm check clean. (edit tool silently failed again — used node scripts with byte-exact 2-space indentation.)

tasks.title: Migration: migrateToGlobalSequence (renumber by createdAt, idempotent)
tasks.description:
NEW `migrateToGlobalSequence` in packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:
- Collect all phases across the project sorted by `createdAt` asc → reassign `number` 1..N globally. All tasks by `createdAt` asc → 1..N globally. All features by `createdAt` asc → 1..N. Set `project.nextPhaseNumber = maxPhase+1`, `nextTaskNumber = maxTask+1`, `nextFeatureNumber = maxFeature+1`. Persist.
- Idempotent: skip (return early, no changes) if there are NO duplicate phase numbers across the project AND no duplicate task numbers (already effectively global). Use a helper `hasDuplicateNumbers(entities)`.
- Wire into the startup migration path (alongside migrateToUuids in plan-store or the pi-adapter/plan-mcp startup) so it runs once on first load after deploy.
- Edge: stable tie-break by `id` when `createdAt` ties (avoid non-deterministic renumber).
Write a functional test: load this project's .planner (16 phases, 72 tasks), run migration, assert no duplicate phase/task numbers, counters = max+1, re-running is a no-op.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added migrateToGlobalSequence (module-level exported fn in plan-store.ts, mirrors migrateToUuids). Runs in runBatchForMigration. Loads all, collects every task across phases. If NO duplicate phase/task/feature numbers exist → no-op (only ensures counters if project.json predates them). Else: renumbers all features/phases/tasks by createdAt asc (stable tiebreak by id) into a single project-wide 1..N sequence, sets project counters = max+1, saves features + each phase + project + writeGenerated. Exported from packages/plan-core/src/index.ts.

Wired into BOTH adapters' lazy one-time startup:
- pi-adapter heavy init (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts, after migrateToUuids): await migrateToGlobalSequence(st).catch(()=>null).
- plan-mcp requireStore() (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, after ensureShortIdsAndPriority): await migrateToGlobalSequence(st).catch(()=>{}).

Functional test on a COPY of this .planner (19 phases, 81 tasks, 7 features): BEFORE had 13 duplicate phase numbers + 69 duplicate task numbers (per-parent). AFTER: all 19 phases unique (1-19), all 81 tasks unique (1-81), counters nextPhase=20/nextTask=82/nextFeature=8 (=max+1). Re-run idempotent (migrated:false, numbers unchanged). project.json persisted counters. Bare P003 now unique.

NOTE: edit tool silently failed on 2 multi-edit attempts (returned only a reminder). Used node scripts with byte-exact indentation + a single writeFileSync-at-end pattern (apply all reps, then write once) to avoid losing changes when a later rep failed.

tasks.title: refs.ts: shared findTaskByRef (bare T00x + composite + shortId)
tasks.description:
packages/plan-core/src/refs.ts:
1. Add shared `findTaskByRef(phases, features, ref)` accepting (case-insensitive): UUID (task.id); bare `T00x` (now unambiguous — find the one task with that global number across all phases); composite `F00x/P00x/T00x` and `P00x(F00x)/T00x` (validate parent phase/feature); 5-char shortId (task.shortId); title exact then includes (backward-compat). Return `{ phase, task }`.
2. Update findPhaseByRef doc comment: `phase.number` is now TRULY globally unique (was per-feature). Resolution logic unchanged (already accepts bare P00x).
3. Export findTaskByRef from packages/plan-core/src/index.ts alongside findPhaseByRef.
Test: findTaskByRef resolves bare "T001", "F001/P002/T003", shortId "UUXD1", UUID, title.

---
**Completion summary:**
Added shared findTaskByRef to packages/plan-core/src/refs.ts (exported via `export * from "./refs.js"` in core index). Accepts (case-insensitive): UUID (task.id), bare T00x (now globally unambiguous — finds the one task with that global number across all phases), composite F00x/P00x/T00x + P00x(F00x)/T00x + P00x/T00x (validates parent phase + optional feature), 5-char shortId, title exact-then-includes. Returns { phase, task } | undefined. Added parseTaskComposite helper extracting feature/phase/task numbers with `0*` zero-padding tolerance ("t3"=="t003"). Fixed exactOptionalPropertyTypes on its return type.

findPhaseByRef doc comment already says "phase.number (globally unique)" — now actually true post-migration; left as-is.

Functional test on migrated copy: bare T00x ✅, composite F/P/T ✅ (F005/P014/T006), P(F)/T ✅, P/T ✅, shortId ✅, UUID ✅, title ✅, composite-wrong-F rejected ✅, nonexistent T999 ✅, findPhaseByRef bare P014 ✅. (Encountered a pre-existing data quirk: a task whose phaseId field didn't match its containing phase — findTaskByRef handled it correctly via the containing phase; not in scope to fix here.)
